about: Every place the Elden Ring DLL touches the game. Target: eldenring.exe 2.7.1.0 (1.17.1) on this PC. 'found' = located in code/crate; 'verified' = seen working in the running game.

rows.what: Wait until the game window exists and reflection singletons resolve before touching game state
rows.notes: field note gotchas 1-2: use reflection name CSTask, never scan from DllMain

rows.what: The local player: position, block position, HP, death
Write position, orientation, proxy-update flag; gravity_multiplier / gravity_disabled
rows.notes: field note: gravity must be 0 while we drive or a scripted fall death fires

rows.what: A per-frame callback after character physics, to apply the Minecraft pose
rows.how: CSTask registration at a post-physics task group
rows.notes: exact task group to confirm in game

rows.what: Read and blank keyboard/mouse for the game
rows.notes: field note: game uses GetDeviceState only

rows.what: Ray casts against map collision near the player
rows.notes: map re-basing shifts Havok coords: resync on warp

rows.what: Draw our geometry and overlay inside the game's frame
rows.how: hudhook DX12 pre-ImGui / post-ImGui hooks (patched as in field note)

rows.what: Copy scene depth (D32_FLOAT_S8X24, reversed Z) to occlude our 3D draws
rows.how: at the first ClearDepthStencilView of the main DSV each frame
rows.notes: fall back to last copy on alt-tab (gotcha 9)

rows.what: Which ER menu is open; hide ER HUD
Nearby enemies: position, HP, team, last_hit_by
rows.notes: distance field is relative, not metres

rows.what: Make an engine hit on an enemy so ER does damage, reactions and sounds
rows.notes: no edited regulation.bin: shipping one would redistribute a game file and one-click can't rebuild it. Use vanilla rows (throwing-dagger family) + direct HP write for the exact Minecraft damage; bullet life >= 2 frames (gotcha 7)

rows.what: Read the active camera's forward vector for Minecraft's look
rows.notes: if look comes out reversed, the camera looks along -row2

rows.what: Draw flat-coloured triangles and lines in the world
rows.notes: unknown whether retail renders debug draw without extra flags: first in-game check
